An individual known only as '''Darklighter''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He escaped the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] aboard the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']].

{{Char-stub}}
